summary: Một ứng dụng CAD viết bằng Rust cho bản vẽ 2D/3D với hỗ trợ DWG/DXF và render GPU gia tốc.
usecases: Professional CAD drafting and design using open-source tools.
DWG/DXF file conversion and editing without proprietary software.
ideas: Integrate with cloud-based design collaboration platforms.
Add a plugin system for custom commands or exporters.
Develop a web-based viewer using WebGPU for remote access.
